kit._note: Keep Your Distance is the hop_away trait: when an enemy comes within a hex, she hops a hex away, once every 6s.

basic_attack.name: Longshot
basic_attack.text: Shoots her target from up to 4 hexes away.

signature._note: Marked for its own 4s: +15% damage taken from everyone.
signature.name: Marking Shot
signature.text: Marks the nearest enemy within 4 hexes, so it takes more damage from everyone for a while.

passives.name: Slip Away
passives.text: Each time she hops away, she slips from sight for a moment: no enemy can target her.
